description:
## Context

`Renderer` is currently a GenServer that wraps its computation state (`previous`, `width`, `height`, `full_redraws`, `throttle`) and exposes `render/4`, `resize/3`, `full_redraws/1`, `render_count/1` via `GenServer.call`. Making it a pure module removes the process hop on every frame and simplifies the test surface significantly.

## Implementation

### Step 1 — Define the struct

Replace the GenServer with a plain struct:

```elixir
defstruct width: 80, height: 24, previous: nil, full_redraws: 0

@type t :: %__MODULE__{
  width: pos_integer(),
  height: pos_integer(),
  previous: [binary()] | nil,
  full_redraws: non_neg_integer()
}
```

### Step 2 — Convert public API

- `Renderer.new(opts)` — replaces `start_link/1`
- `Renderer.render(r, lines, cursor_seq \\ "")` — returns `{bytes, new_r}` instead of `{:ok, bytes}`
- `Renderer.resize(r, width, height)` — returns `new_r` instead of `:ok`
- `Renderer.find_diff_range/2` — stays public (used in tests)
- Remove `start_link/1`, `full_redraws/1`, `render_count/1`, `handle_call` callbacks

Move `check_width_overflow/2` from `RenderThrottle` into `Renderer` since it belongs with the renderer's width-awareness.

### Step 3 — Update renderer_test.exs

Replace all `start_link` + `GenServer.call` patterns with direct struct calls:

```elixir
r = Renderer.new(width: 40, height: 10)
{bytes, r} = Renderer.render(r, ["Line 0", "Line 1"])
{bytes2, _r} = Renderer.render(r, ["Line 0", "Line 1"])
assert bytes2 == ""
```

`full_redraws` becomes a field on the struct, readable directly in tests.

### Step 4 — Remove from supervision

Remove `Renderer` from the `OctoPi.TUI.Application` supervisor (it is currently started there or by `Interactive.run/1` — verify and remove whichever).

## Acceptance criteria

- `Renderer` has no `use GenServer`, no `start_link`, no `handle_*` callbacks
- `Renderer.render/3` returns `{bytes, new_renderer}` (pure)
- `Renderer.resize/3` returns `new_renderer` (pure)
- `check_width_overflow/2` moved from `RenderThrottle` into `Renderer`
- All renderer tests pass using direct struct calls — no process setup/teardown
- `Renderer` removed from any supervision tree
- `tui_render` tracer spec events for `[:octo_pi_tui, :renderer, :render]` still emitted (telemetry call moves into the pure `render/3` function)
title: Convert Renderer from GenServer to pure module
